summary: nginx 1.31.7 and 1.30.6 fix five medium worker issues: an alias-and-rewrite buffer overflow, a script-evaluation buffer overflow, HTTP/3 request-body injection, TLS session-ticket forgery, and an AIO use-after-free.
remediation: Upgrade nginx to 1.31.7 or newer on the mainline, or to 1.30.6 or newer on the 1.30 stable line.
